title: kb-sprint says how to run workers from a second clone
goal: The kb-sprint skill and kb/_self/backlog.md, Working on items, say how an orchestrator whose sprint runs in a separate clone (another sprint holds the session's own clone) gives each subagent its own worktree and work/<id> branch of that clone, since the Agent tool's isolation: worktree branches from the session's working directory; selfdoc.py check passes (SP-xourq2gj retrospective: the orchestrator created the worktrees by hand)

gates.question: For a sprint in a second clone, which way do the skill and runbook give first?
options: a fresh Claude session in that clone first, hand-made worktrees (agent without isolation) as the fallback
hand-made worktrees from the current session first
only a fresh Claude session in that clone
gates.recommendation: a fresh Claude session in that clone first, hand-made worktrees (agent without isolation) as the fallback
gates.answer: a fresh Claude session in that clone first, hand-made worktrees (agent without isolation) as the fallback
